saints.name: The Annunciation of the Lord
saints.title: Solemnity of the Lord
saints.shortBlurb: The angel Gabriel announced to the Virgin Mary that she would bear the Son of God, and at her “yes” the Word was made flesh…
biography: The Gospel of St. Luke recounts how the angel Gabriel was sent to Mary at Nazareth to announce that she would conceive by the Holy Spirit and bear a son, Jesus, the Son of the Most High. At her free consent, “Be it done unto me according to thy word,” the eternal Word took flesh in her womb.

Kept nine months before Christmas, the feast is among the most ancient of the Church's celebrations of the Incarnation. It honors both the mystery of God made man and the faith and obedience of the Virgin who received him.
saints.knownFor: The Incarnation of the Word — “and the Word was made flesh.”
